title: Glowing pretzel
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <!-- shadow/glow halo behind pretzel -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='34' ry='30' fill='#5a2a06' opacity='0.5'/>
    <!-- pretzel outer loop: big rounded heart-like knot -->
    <path d='M30 38 C18 30 14 46 22 54 C26 58 30 56 32 52
             C34 48 34 42 40 40
             C46 38 50 44 50 50
             C50 44 54 38 60 40
             C66 42 66 48 68 52
             C70 56 74 58 78 54
             C86 46 82 30 70 38'
          stroke='#c96a12' stroke-width='11' fill='none'/>
    <!-- inner edges lighter highlight -->
    <path d='M30 38 C18 30 14 46 22 54 C26 58 30 56 32 52
             C34 48 34 42 40 40
             C46 38 50 44 50 50
             C50 44 54 38 60 40
             C66 42 66 48 68 52
             C70 56 74 58 78 54
             C86 46 82 30 70 38'
          stroke='#ffb64d' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
    <!-- salt dots -->
    <g fill='#fff2cc'>
      <circle cx='24' cy='40' r='1.8'/>
      <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='1.6'/>
      <circle cx='22' cy='52' r='1.5'/>
      <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='1.7'/>
      <circle cx='56' cy='40' r='1.7'/>
      <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='1.6'/>
      <circle cx='76' cy='40' r='1.8'/>
      <circle cx='34' cy='56' r='1.5'/>
      <circle cx='66' cy='56' r='1.5'/>
      <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='1.4'/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
